exposure: time lag between previous C-section and current delivery
type of previous C-section (elective vs. emergency)
cohort: Pregnant women with PAS referred to a referral hospital in northern Iran between 2016 and 2021
finding: In addition to repeated C-sections, a history of prior abortion was found to be a significant risk factor for placenta accreta syndrome, leading to lower gestational age at delivery and increased risks of surgical complications.
